description: A function line profiling was aimed at, and the count that picked it: what took the user's time most.

function.description: What's profiled, by its dotted name.

kind.description: The count that picked it: a button's, row's or menu item's handler (handler), a main-loop callback (callback), a wire op the host answered (op).

name.description: The count's name (the handler's or callback's function, the op).

count.description: Its times in the stretch it was picked from (the last day).

seconds.description: Its time added up in that stretch: what it was picked by, the most first.
